title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
帐篷里气氛一时间有些奇怪。主要是卢克的问题。他并不擅长跟未成年人沟通，倾向于丁克，以至于婚后跟前妻一直没有生育。所以他面对突然冒出来的表弟表妹，表现得有些无所适从。好在这对于印第安少年罗伯特来说不是问题，因为他是个标准的话痨。“卢克表哥，你在纽约布鲁克林大桥上的表现实在太酷了，能告诉我你是怎么拥有现在的超级力量的吗？”“是不是就跟好莱坞电影里一样，被一个邪恶的组织偷偷抓去做了人体实验，然后你历经各种磨难，终于逃了出来？”“又或者说，你是被实验室里培养的特殊动物咬了，类似于天牛之类的......”天知道现在的小孩每天都在看些什么。面对罗伯特抛出来的各种稀奇古怪的问题，卢克头更大了。他挥手制止了这小子继续说下去，无奈道：“停，你说的这些情况我统统没有遇到过，事实上，我是在被几个黑人打劫，然后又被捅了一刀后，突然觉醒的。”“就这么简单？”罗伯特有些不敢置信。“没错，就这么简单，我认为是我母亲留给我的黑曜石手链赐予了我力量，你们似乎认识它？”卢克同样注意到了刚才他们频频看向自己手链的异常表现，所以他试图从这两位表弟表妹这里了解更多的信息。“对，我们见过它。”一旁的印第安少女米娜点头道：“我们母亲手腕上有一条一模一样的，据说是她小时候因为调皮，把祖母箱子里的一把黑曜石匕首弄碎了，后来索菲亚阿姨为了安慰她，就把那些匕首碎片收集起来，打磨成了两条可以佩戴的手链，她们每人各佩戴一条。”“这样吗？”卢克闻言露出若有所思之色，明白了他们两人刚才为什么突然能认出自己。这还真是够巧的。不过从这件事来看，琳达阿姨跟母亲关系似乎很好，如果能跟她见一面的话，自己或许可以从她那里了解到母亲更多的过往。“......”而对于卢克提出的这个请求，无论是话痨的罗伯特，还是性格活泼的米娜都面露一丝难色。罗伯特有些垂头丧气地道：“我妈妈生病了，脑癌晚期，现在正躺在医院里昏迷不醒，医生说如果不进行手术的话，她最多还有三个月的寿命......所以我跟姐姐正在想办法凑手术费和住院费......”“呃......”卢克顿时语塞。他想了想上前一步，抬手轻轻抱住了这两个还没成年的孩子，语气沉重的道：“我很抱歉听到这个消息，罗伯特，米娜，我想，或许我可以帮上一些忙。”“太好了。”罗伯特听到这话眼睛都亮了起来，抬起头问道：“卢克表哥，你是不是打算用你的超能力治好我的母亲？”“不。”卢克摇了摇头，神色认真地道：“我打算抢银行。”“啊？”罗伯特：（（（;???;）））米娜：o（?Д?）っ！......卢克说这话是认真的。连续两次出现的真实梦境，让他对阿兹特克帝国战士修尔斯这个身份很有代入感，也让获得超能力后一直迷茫的他，心中冥冥间多出了一份使命感。他认为自己之所以能在将死之际获得阿兹特克神灵的赐福，或许就是那位神灵希望自己取回那件属于阿兹特克人的圣物。

而现在听到两位表弟表妹目前缺钱的困境后，他抢银行的理由又多出了一个。“所以，你要去抢美国第一国家银行？”罗伯特听完人都傻了。他没想到自己这位表哥竟然是这么莽的，连地方小银行都看不上，要抢就抢宾夕法尼亚州最大的银行。那里可是据说有着两百多年历史，以及牢不可破金库的美国第一银行啊！！卢克表哥的拳头能打破那里将近一米厚的金库大门吗？“我有着必须去那的理由，那的保险柜里存放着一件对于印第安人来说很重要的东西。”尽管知道这很难，卢克并没有打算改变主意。他觉得既然战士修尔斯留下的遗物，让自己报了仇，没有就那样窝囊的死去，那他也有义务去帮助修尔斯完成他最后的执念。“我明白了，卢克表哥，如果你只是想要从美国第一银行的保险柜里拿一件东西，顺便再帮我妈妈凑齐手术费的话，其实没必要硬闯。”“因为一般来说，像美国第一银行这种老牌银行的保险柜，是跟金库分开的，而且因为它成立的时间太早，这两百年都没换过位置，它地下的防备并不是很严密，有一条下水道正好经过银行下方，我们可以从那挖一条隧道，悄悄的进去......”不同于罗伯特的吃惊，米娜站在那想了一会，居然向卢克提出了一个十分有用且详细的建议。比如说，他们该通过怎样的方式，确定美国第一银行内部的布局以及保险柜的位置，以及通过勾股定理，就可以计算出下水道到银行内部的隧道，该倾斜多少度，才能正好向上打到银行内部去。“？？？”等米娜一股脑说完自己的计划后，轮到卢克震惊了。他看着自己面前短短时间内，就想出了一个完美无缺抢银行计划的黑发女孩，张了张嘴惊叹道：“米娜，你可真是个天才！！”......“我可真是个天才。”与此同时，在宾夕法尼亚州首都费城，利用来自比翼鸟的天赋能力，陆白旁若无人地行走在美国第一国家银行内部。无论是银行内的工作人员，还是持枪四处巡逻的警卫，都对他们面前多出了一个陌生人熟视无睹。甚至安装在各处的摄像头，也没有拍摄到任何有关陆白的画面。他就像一个空气人般，轻松来到了美国第一国家银行放置保险柜的房间。这里摆满了一排排保险柜。其中最早的，甚至可以追溯到美国南北战争那会儿。出于民众对保存贵重物品，一些从战争中得到的不义之财的需求，早在1861年保险柜存放业务就在美国初具规模。像美国第一国家银行这种有着几百年历史的老银行，保险柜内更是有着一些时间久到没人认领的物件。比如说现在，精神力在这一排排保险柜内扫过，陆白很快就发现了一个符合自己需求的。这个保险柜里存放着十几公斤黄金，两千美金，一把柯尔特M1851海军转轮手枪，以及一本牛皮笔记本。根据笔记本上记载的内容，陆白确定了这个保险柜的主人。一名美国南北战争时期北方联邦陆军的少校。在参加战争之前，因为担心自己回不来，他将这些贵重物品存放了这家银行里，并且一次性缴纳了所有保管费用，保证这些物品可以一直存放。这样的话，如果他死在了战场上，他在欧洲的家人收到信后，还有机会在战争结束之后来银行拿回这些东西。可惜，世事无常，他的家人应该没收到那封信。这些东西保存在银行保险柜里，一直无人问津，直到现在陆白发现了它们。

The atmosphere in the tent was a little strange for a while.Mainly Luke's problem.He was not good at communicating with minors and tended to be DINK, so that he and his ex-wife never had children after marriage.So when he faced his cousins ​​who suddenly appeared, he seemed a little at a loss.Fortunately, this is not a problem for the Indian boy Robert, because he is a standard talker."Cousin Luke, your performance on the Brooklyn Bridge in New York was so cool. Can you tell me how you got the super strength you have now?" "Is it just like in the Hollywood movie, where you were secretly captured by an evil organization and used for human experiments, and then you went through all kinds of hardships and finally escaped?" "Or maybe you were bitten by a special animal cultivated in the laboratory, similar to a beetle..." God knows what children today are watching every day.Facing all kinds of weird questions raised by Robert, Luke's head got even bigger.He waved his hand to stop the kid from continuing, and said helplessly: "Stop, I have never encountered any of the situations you mentioned. In fact, I suddenly woke up after being robbed by several black men and then stabbed again." "Is it that simple?" Robert couldn't believe it."Yes, it's that simple. I think it was the obsidian bracelet my mother left for me that gave me strength. Do you seem to recognize it?" Luke also noticed the unusual behavior of them frequently looking at his bracelet just now, so he tried to learn more information from these two cousins."Yes, we have seen it." The Indian girl Mina on the side nodded and said: "Our mother has an exact one on her wrist. It is said that she broke an obsidian dagger in her grandmother's box because she was naughty when she was a child. Later, in order to comfort her, Aunt Sofia collected the dagger fragments and polished them into two wearable bracelets. Each of them wore one." "Is this so?" Luke looked thoughtful after hearing this, understanding why the two of them suddenly recognized themselves just now.This is quite a coincidence.However, judging from this incident, Aunt Linda seems to have a very good relationship with her mother. If she could meet her, I might be able to learn more about her mother's past from her."..." Regarding Luke's request, both the talkative Robert and the lively Mina looked a bit embarrassed.Robert said with some dejection: "My mother is sick, with terminal brain cancer, and she is lying in a coma in the hospital. The doctor said that if she does not undergo surgery, she will have up to three months to live... So my sister and I are trying to find ways to collect the surgery and hospitalization expenses..." "Uh..." Luke was suddenly speechless.He thought for a moment and stepped forward, raised his hands and gently hugged the two children who were not yet adults, and said in a serious tone: "I'm sorry to hear this news, Robert, Mina. I think maybe I can be of some help." "Great." Robert's eyes lit up when he heard this.He raised his head and asked: "Cousin Luke, are you planning to use your superpower to cure my mother?" "No." Luke shook his head and said seriously: "I plan to rob the bank." "Huh?" Robert: (((;???;)))) Mina: o (?Д?)っ!...Luke meant what he said.The real dreams that appeared twice in a row made him feel very connected to the identity of the Aztec Empire warrior Seuls. It also gave him a sense of mission in his heart, which had been confused since he obtained superpowers.He believed that the reason why he was blessed by the Aztec gods when he was about to die was that the gods wanted him to retrieve the sacred object belonging to the Aztecs.

And now after hearing about the current plight of his two cousins ​​who were short of money, he had another reason to rob the bank."So, you are going to rob the First National Bank of the United States?" Robert was dumbfounded after hearing this.He didn't expect that his cousin would be so reckless. He didn't even look down on small local banks. If he wanted to rob, he would rob the largest bank in Pennsylvania.There is the First Bank of the United States, which is said to have a history of more than 200 years and an unbreakable vault!!Can Cousin Luke's fist break the nearly one meter thick vault door there?"I have a reason to go there. There is something very important to the Indians stored in the safe there." Although he knew it would be difficult, Luke did not intend to change his mind.He felt that since the relics left by the soldier Shouls allowed him to avenge himself and did not die a useless death, then he also had an obligation to help Shouls fulfill his last obsession."I understand, Cousin Luke, if you just want to get something from the safe of First Bank of America and help my mother collect the surgery fee, there is no need to break in." "Because generally speaking, the safes of old banks like First Bank of America are separate from the vaults, and because it was established so long ago"Good morning, it hasn't changed location in the past two hundred years, and its underground defenses are not very tight. There is a sewer passing under the bank. We can dig a tunnel from there and sneak in..." Unlike Robert's surprise, Mina stood there and thought for a while, and actually made a very useful and detailed suggestion to Luke.For example, how should they determine the internal layout of the First Bank of the United States and the location of the safes? And through the Pythagorean theorem, they can calculate how much the tunnel from the sewer to the inside of the bank should be tilted to reach the inside of the bank."???" After Mina finished talking about her plan, it was Luke's turn to be shocked.He looked at the black-haired girl in front of him who had come up with a flawless plan to rob a bank in a short period of time. He opened his mouth and exclaimed: "Mina, you are such a genius!!"... "I am such a genius." At the same time, in Philadelphia, the capital of Pennsylvania, Lu Bai used the talent from the Birds to walk inside the First National Bank of the United States as if there was no one else around.Both the staff in the bank and the guards patrolling with guns turned a blind eye to the presence of a stranger in front of them.Even the cameras installed everywhere did not capture any footage of Lu Bai.Like an airman, he easily arrived at the room where the safe was placed at the First National Bank.The place is filled with rows and rows of safes.The earliest of them can even be traced back to the American Civil War.Due to the public's need to preserve valuables and some ill-gotten gains from the war, the safe storage business began to take shape in the United States as early as 1861.An old bank like the First National Bank of the United States with a history of hundreds of years has some items in the safe that have been unclaimed for a long time.For example, now, as Lu Bai scanned the rows of safes with his mental power, he quickly found one that met his needs.This safe contained more than ten kilograms of gold, two thousand US dollars, a Colt M1851 naval revolver, and a cowhide notebook.Based on the contents recorded in the notebook, Lu Bai determined the owner of the safe.A major in the Union Army during the American Civil War.Before joining the war, because he was worried that he would not be able to come back, he stored these valuable items in this bank and paid all the storage fees in one go to ensure that these items could be stored forever.In this way, if he died on the battlefield, his family in Europe would have the opportunity to come to the bank to retrieve these things after the war was over.Unfortunately, as things happen, his family may not have received the letter.These things were kept in a bank safe and no one cared about them until Lu Bai discovered them now.

而现在听到两位表弟表妹目前缺钱的困境后，他抢银行的理由又多出了一个。“所以，你要去抢美国第一国家银行？”罗伯特听完人都傻了。他没想到自己这位表哥竟然是这么莽的，连地方小银行都看不上，要抢就抢宾夕法尼亚州最大的银行。那里可是据说有着两百多年历史，以及牢不可破金库的美国第一银行啊！！卢克表哥的拳头能打破那里将近一米厚的金库大门吗？“我有着必须去那的理由，那的保险柜里存放着一件对于印第安人来说很重要的东西。”尽管知道这很难，卢克并没有打算改变主意。他觉得既然战士修尔斯留下的遗物，让自己报了仇，没有就那样窝囊的死去，那他也有义务去帮助修尔斯完成他最后的执念。“我明白了，卢克表哥，如果你只是想要从美国第一银行的保险柜里拿一件东西，顺便再帮我妈妈凑齐手术费的话，其实没必要硬闯。”“因为一般来说，像美国第一银行这种老牌银行的保险柜，是跟金库分开的，而且因为它成立的时间太早，这两百年都没换过位置，它地下的防备并不是很严密，有一条下水道正好经过银行下方，我们可以从那挖一条隧道，悄悄的进去......”不同于罗伯特的吃惊，米娜站在那想了一会，居然向卢克提出了一个十分有用且详细的建议。比如说，他们该通过怎样的方式，确定美国第一银行内部的布局以及保险柜的位置，以及通过勾股定理，就可以计算出下水道到银行内部的隧道，该倾斜多少度，才能正好向上打到银行内部去。“？？？”等米娜一股脑说完自己的计划后，轮到卢克震惊了。他看着自己面前短短时间内，就想出了一个完美无缺抢银行计划的黑发女孩，张了张嘴惊叹道：“米娜，你可真是个天才！！”......“我可真是个天才。”与此同时，在宾夕法尼亚州首都费城，利用来自比翼鸟的天赋能力，陆白旁若无人地行走在美国第一国家银行内部。无论是银行内的工作人员，还是持枪四处巡逻的警卫，都对他们面前多出了一个陌生人熟视无睹。甚至安装在各处的摄像头，也没有拍摄到任何有关陆白的画面。他就像一个空气人般，轻松来到了美国第一国家银行放置保险柜的房间。这里摆满了一排排保险柜。其中最早的，甚至可以追溯到美国南北战争那会儿。出于民众对保存贵重物品，一些从战争中得到的不义之财的需求，早在1861年保险柜存放业务就在美国初具规模。像美国第一国家银行这种有着几百年历史的老银行，保险柜内更是有着一些时间久到没人认领的物件。比如说现在，精神力在这一排排保险柜内扫过，陆白很快就发现了一个符合自己需求的。这个保险柜里存放着十几公斤黄金，两千美金，一把柯尔特M1851海军转轮手枪，以及一本牛皮笔记本。根据笔记本上记载的内容，陆白确定了这个保险柜的主人。一名美国南北战争时期北方联邦陆军的少校。在参加战争之前，因为担心自己回不来，他将这些贵重物品存放了这家银行里，并且一次性缴纳了所有保管费用，保证这些物品可以一直存放。这样的话，如果他死在了战场上，他在欧洲的家人收到信后，还有机会在战争结束之后来银行拿回这些东西。可惜，世事无常，他的家人应该没收到那封信。这些东西保存在银行保险柜里，一直无人问津，直到现在陆白发现了它们。
